C-ADD-POSTING-CONTRACT.Summary: Introduce IC-POSTING-V1 and the ordered DF-POSTING flow across UI, API, and core.
C-ADD-POSTING-CONTRACT.Problem: Posting behavior was implicit; no versioned schema linked gateway to core.

Goals.Goal: Publish OpenAPI posting schema and wire Provider/Consumer modules under IC-POSTING-V1.

Constraints.Constraint: Ceremony tier T2 (cross-cutting): multi-package, integration gates required.
BreakingChangePolicy additive-only for the first major contract version.

NonGoals.NonGoal: gRPC transport (HTTP JSON only for v1).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTRACT-WIRED: IC-POSTING-V1 owns Schema openapi/posting.yaml with Provider M-LEDGER-CORE and Consumer M-API-ROUTER.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-FLOW-ORDERED: DF-POSTING declares ordered steps UI → API → Core.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Project lints clean; IC and DF project into the graph without shape errors.

Assumptions.Assumption: OpenAPI file lands under openapi/ at repo root of this example.
